pine_bollinger_bands.name: Pine — Bollinger Bands
pine_bollinger_bands.description: 20-period Bollinger Bands (2σ) computed via the openbb-pine compiler + PyneCore runtime.

params.source:
//@version=6
indicator("BB", overlay=true)
length = input.int(20, minval=1)
mult = input.float(2.0, minval=0.1)
basis = ta.sma(close, length)
dev = mult * ta.stdev(close, length)
plot(basis, title="basis", color=color.orange)
plot(basis + dev, title="upper", color=color.blue)
plot(basis - dev, title="lower", color=color.blue)
